newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua closes borders to Salvadoran beef.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua closes borders to Salvadoran beef.

text.p: Nicaragua on Tuesday closed its borders to Salvadoran beef imports in a tit-for-tat measure in response to El Salvador's blockage of Nicaraguan beef imports.

"El Salvador has closed its borders to Nicaraguan beef, and we as well have given instructions that Salvadoran products coming directly to Nicaragua be blocked at the border," Nicaraguan President Arnoldo Aleman told reporters.
Aleman said he had given instructions to the ministries of agriculture and the economy to stop trucks loaded with Salvadoran beef at the border.
The move came after Nicaragua protested that El Salvador had been blocking Nicaraguan beef at its borders since last week.
Aleman said the measure would remain in effect until El Salvador lifted its restriction on Nicaraguan beef.
He said El Salvador had not told him why it was blocking Nicaraguan beef imports.

El Salvador is Nicaragua's largest market for beef, accounting for 30 percent of its total exports worth $20 million a year, the president of the Nicaraguan National Cattle Commission, Juan Tijerino, said.
Tijerino said El Salvador was breaking market liberalization measures agreed to in the C-4 Treaty, an economic integration agreement signed by Nicaragua, El Salvador, Guatemala and Honduras.
